steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with a free glutamine residue in the unbound amino acid pool.
Form the first peptide bond by reacting the amine group of glutamine with a carboxyl group.
Fix the covalent amide bond, creating a permanent record of the linkage.
Extend the peptide backbone by adding the next amino acid residue.
Branch the glutamine side chain into hydrogen bond donor and acceptor arms.
Form a stable hydrogen bond on the donor arm with a neighboring residue.
Encounter a steric clash on the acceptor arm, preventing bond formation.
Rejoin the donor and acceptor arms to define the local conformational state of the residue.
Hold the dual-role amide group as both donor and acceptor simultaneously.
Dissolve a hydrogen bond to allow conformational rearrangement.
Maintain the identity of the glutamine residue within the growing chain.
Add another amino acid residue to the backbone, continuing the linear composition.
Anchor the system in the complete, folded protein tertiary structure.
